title: Pretty, wide bottomed kettle
text:
Pretty, wide bottomed kettle. Beautiful kettle and very wide bottom, so it heats up quite quickly on my largest burner.

Nice handle/spout mechanism.

Great price for a quality product.

product_metadata.title: Mr. Coffee Flintshire Stainless Steel Whistling Tea Kettle W/Nylon Handle, 1.75-Quart, Metallic Royal Blue
features: Whistling teakettle alerts when water is boiling recommend you to move after Whistle has been blown
Flip-up spout cover for safe and easy pouring with Bakelite stay cool handles and trigger for safety
Do Not overfill kettle. Fill no higher than just spout opening
description: This stainless steel tea kettle with whistle features a brushed satin finish exterior, mirror base and lid, and nylon handle.
